notes.title: Brand New Update: Best of 2024 Event Quiz
notes.notes:
The holidays are here, and what better way to celebrate than with a fun-filled trivia showdown with friends and family? We've just released a free "Best of 2024" quiz for It's Quiz Time, packed with  thousands of  new questions about all the biggest events of the year!

Think you know 2024 best?  Challenge your friends and family to see who can rack up the highest score!

[b]Here's why you need this update:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]It's the ultimate party starter:[/b] Get everyone laughing and engaged with this fun and competitive quiz.
[*] [b]Something for everyone:[/b] With questions ranging from pop culture and sports to science and current events, there's something to challenge everyone from your youngest niece to your know-it-all grandpa. 😉
[*] [b]Easy to play:[/b] Up to 8 players can join in using their smartphones as controllers – no extra controllers needed!
[*] [b]Perfect for holiday gatherings:[/b] Skip the awkward small talk and bond over some friendly competition.
[*] [b]Reflect on the year that was:[/b] Remember all the highs and lows of 2024 and test your knowledge of the year's biggest moments.
[/list]

Ready to put your 2024 knowledge to the test?

Download the latest update for It's Quiz Time and you'll immediately have free access to the "Best of 2024" Event Quiz.

Happy quizzing, and have a great time with your friends & family!

- Snap Finger Click

notes.title: 'Tis the Season for Trivia: Unwrap the Best of 2023 Event Quiz
notes.notes:
As the year draws to a close and the holiday spirit fills the air, it's time to gather your loved ones, whip out your smartphones, and prepare for an unforgettable trivia showdown with the Best of 2023 Event Quiz for It's Quiz Time!

This [i]free(!)[/i] festive update is the perfect way to test your knowledge of the year's most memorable moments, from groundbreaking scientific discoveries to nail-biting sporting events. With over 1700 questions covering a wide range of topics, the Best of 2023 Event Quiz will keep everyone entertained and engaged, whether you're a seasoned trivia aficionado or a curious newcomer to the world of brain teasers.

But why is this quiz the ultimate holiday companion? Here are just a few reasons:

[b]1. The Perfect Party Starter:[/b]

No holiday gathering is complete without a touch of friendly competition, and the Best of 2023 Event Quiz is the ideal way to get everyone laughing, cheering, and flexing their mental muscles. Up to eight players can join in the fun using their smartphones as controllers, creating an immersive and interactive experience for all.

[b]2. A Rewarding Challenge for All Ages:[/b]

The quiz's diverse range of questions ensures that everyone, from young to old, can find something to challenge their minds and engage their interests. Whether it's pop culture trivia for the music enthusiasts, science-based questions for the budding scientists, or sports trivia for the armchair athletes, the Best of 2023 Event Quiz has something for everyone.

[b]3. A Fun Way to Reflect on the Year:[/b]

As we bid farewell to another year, the Best of 2023 Event Quiz provides a lighthearted and enjoyable way to look back on all the significant events that shaped 2023. Revisit the year's triumphs, relive the unforgettable moments, and test your memory alongside your loved ones.


So, what are you waiting for? Gather your friends and family, grab your smartphones, and download the Best of 2023 Event Quiz for It's Quiz Time today! Let the holiday spirit fill your homes with laughter and the thrill of intellectual competition. Happy holidays and happy quizzing!

notes.title: A new party game from the developers of It's Quiz Time!
notes.notes:

[b]Awkward 2[/b] is a brand new upcoming multiplayer experience for adults, from the creators of It's Quiz Time. The game now has its first official gameplay trailer and you can watch it right here:

[previewyoutube=gTSiInMrjAY;full][/previewyoutube]

Awkward 2 is an adult multiplayer party game filled with dark, hilarious & sometimes downright disturbing questions. Laugh, debate, defend yourself and find out things you never wanted to know about your friends and family!

Want to find out more? Make sure to check out the official Steam page and don't forget to wishlist!

notes.title: Best of 2020 Quiz Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31157641/357c961ef1b70324e17d822810bbb1c7fa89b6a3.jpg[/img]

The festive season is almost upon us, and that can mean only one thing… It’s Quiz Time’s ‘Best of 2020’ is here![b] It’s Quiz Time’s annual end of year quiz enters its third year better than ever, with 1000 brand new questions[/b] to see how closely you were paying attention in 2020! Covering everything from weird and wonderful news items to current affairs, music, movies, tv and video games, Best of 2020 is available for free to all players.

I think we can all agree that for better or worse, it’s definitely been a memorable year. And with the holiday season coming up, now is the perfect time to break out the party games and turn up the heat with a little fiery friendly competition! This year, things are a little different - we can’t necessarily be with all of our loved ones in the same place, but It’s Quiz Time allows players to connect remotely by broadcasting directly to Twitch, and can even be played via screen share on Zoom and Skype! Players will join the game by downloading the It’s Quiz Time companion app to their smartphone or tablet and entering a room code - it’s that simple!

With [b]11 exciting rounds that pit you against up to 8 players, 5 different game modes, and native Twitch streaming integrated features to host up to 10,000 players[/b], It’s Quiz Time has the perfect way to play no matter how 2020 has you spending the festive season!

It’s Quiz Time’s Best of 2020 is available in English (US, UK and ‘Rest of World’), Spanish, Italian, German and French.

notes.title: It’s Quiz Time Now on Zoom, Discord, Hangout, Skype and 30% Off!
notes.notes:
With lockdown in full swing around the world, we’re playing more online than ever before.
Friends and family are relying on video calls and video games as the safest way to bring
people together, and with It’s Quiz Time on Zoom and Discord you can take connecting with
your loved ones online to another level.

We’ve put together a simple step by step video tutorial for how to get It’s Quiz Time running
in your video call on Zoom, Discord, Skype and Google Hangouts. And to make it even
easier, [b]It’s Quiz Time is now 30% off until 23rd May![/b]

[previewyoutube=xW_Q-luIGRM;full][/previewyoutube]

Invite up to 8 players to compete head to head, using their smartphones as a controller from
their own home. It’s Quiz Time intelligently tailors each quiz to the player's age, location,
interests and performance and features over 25,000 unique questions, so you’ll get
something different every time you play.

And don’t forget - It’s Quiz Time’s Liveshow mode allows streamers on Twitch or Mixer to
play directly against their audience of up to 10,000 players using chat. It’s a totally unique
way for streamers to engage with their audience and keep viewers hooked.
Sale ends 23rd May so get in on the action while you can!

notes.title: FREE WEEKEND until Sunday 23rd September + TIGA Nomination!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31157641/a2c35e8d8d6b0e9975235478f6f29fb62fd7a871.gif[/img]

A few weeks ago, It’s Quiz Time was nominated for a TIGA Award in Best Puzzle Games and we’re ecstatic to announce that we’ve made the shortlist! Competing against other amazing titles such as Looper and Monument Valley 2, we’re hoping to take home the prize and to celebrate, we’ll be offering It’s Quiz Time for FREE all weekend, as well as 30% off It’s Quiz Time from the 20th September to the 4th October.

Featuring nearly 30,000 topical questions on everything from current events to tv, games and movies, as well as an intelligent database that feeds relevant questions based on players’ age, location and performance, It’s Quiz Time offers a second to none party quiz gaming experience.

You can play It’s Quiz Time for FREE from 20th - 23rd September, giving you a chance to grab your friends and family and go head to head - or take on the Solo Score Attack and prove to yourself you’ve got what it takes to compete on our global leaderboards! 

Following this, we’ll continue the celebration with 30% off It’s Quiz Time until the 4th October, so don’t miss out on your chance to have the biggest EVER party game on pc or console in your Steam library for less than £13!

notes.title: Best of 2017 Event Quiz Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31157641/dee45800b4bf30e2b7d814b503da0801b60f0726.png[/img]

It’s Quiz Time’s first content update rolled out just in time for the new year - our brand new Best of 2017!

With nearly 3,000 brand new questions covering everything that happened last year around the world, the biggest quiz game EVER just got bigger… From the US presidential election, to the spiciest memes on the world wide web. Have you been paying close attention? 

What do you know about Article 50, and what does it mean to “Get Schwifty”?

It’s Quiz Time now has over 28,000 questions in it’s catalogue, making it the biggest party trivia game ever on PC or console! Connect up to 8 players using smartphones and battle it out, or take on our witty and devious host Salli in the Solo Score Attack.

Streamers! We got you covered. With our dedicated live stream mode you can compete with up to 10,000 viewers directly through Twitch, Mixer or YouTube Live in real time! It’s Quiz Time offers a whole new way to engage with your audience and get them involved in the game.

With everything from Pennywise to Russian spies… Download Best of 2017 for free now!

[url=https://youtu.be/Bgg3a5mUzuU]Watch the Best of 2017 trailer![/url]
